name: entity_is_token_span
rationale: The label lower-cases and strips each entity and compares it to gold token spans, so every correct entity must equal a contiguous run of lower-cased text tokens joined by single spaces. This catches `It's`, `Dr. Martin Haskell`, `D & E procedure` and `Geysers Air Monitoring Programs (GAMP)`.

name: entity_lower_substring_of_text
rationale: A gold span is a substring of the lower-cased text, so every correct entity is too. This catches entities that were reformatted or invented.

name: entity_nonempty
rationale: Gold spans contain at least one token, so no correct entity is empty after stripping. This catches blank strings.

name: entities_are_strings
rationale: Gold entities are strings, so a correct list cannot contain numbers, nulls or nested objects. This catches malformed list items.

name: each_entity_token_in_text
rationale: Every token of a gold span is a text token, so each space-separated piece of a correct entity is a lower-cased text token. This catches `It's` and `(GAMP)`.

name: global_count_le_occurrences
rationale: Gold spans occupy distinct, non-overlapping positions, so a string repeated across all fields cannot appear more times than it occurs in the text. This catches `FIFA World Cup 2018` listed under both art and event.

name: per_field_count_le_occurrences
rationale: Within one field, each duplicate of an entity must correspond to a distinct occurrence in the text. This catches spurious repeats inside a field while still allowing `California` twice when it appears twice.

name: total_entity_tokens_le_text_tokens
rationale: Gold spans do not overlap, so their token lengths sum to at most the number of text tokens. This catches heavily duplicated or bloated outputs.

name: total_entities_le_tokens
rationale: Each gold entity uses at least one distinct token, so the entity count cannot exceed the token count. This catches runaway lists.

name: no_internal_double_space
rationale: Gold spans are joined by single spaces, so a stripped entity containing a double space can only be correct if the text itself has one. This catches sloppy spacing.

name: non_overlapping_assignment_exists
rationale: All gold entity instances can be placed on distinct, non-overlapping token positions. A backtracking search rejects only when no such placement exists, and it accepts if any entity cannot be located or the search runs too long.

name: entity_starts_at_token_boundary
rationale: A gold span begins at a token start, so the first word of each correct entity must equal a full text token. This catches fragments cut from the middle of a token.

name: entity_ends_at_token_boundary
rationale: A gold span ends at a token end, so the last word of each correct entity must equal a full text token. This catches outputs like `(GAMP)`.

name: entity_chars_in_text
rationale: Every character of a lower-cased gold span appears in the lower-cased text. This catches transliterations, such as dropped accents, and invented symbols.

name: entity_no_newline
rationale: Gold spans contain no newlines or tabs unless the text does. This catches multi-line junk inside an entity.

name: entity_length_le_text
rationale: A span of the text cannot be longer than the text itself. This catches hallucinated long strings.

name: entity_token_count_le_text
rationale: A correct entity has no more tokens than the text has. This catches oversized entities.

name: no_merged_apostrophe_s
rationale: If the text separates `'s` as its own token, then a correct entity cannot glue it onto a word as in `It's`, unless that glued form appears as a text token. This catches retokenized titles.

name: no_attached_parenthesis
rationale: If parentheses are standalone tokens in the text, then a correct entity cannot contain a word with a parenthesis attached to it. This catches `Programs (GAMP)`.

name: no_attached_period
rationale: A word in a correct entity that ends with a period must be a text token. This catches `Dr.` when the text has `Dr .`.

name: no_html_unescape
rationale: If the text contains a literal `&` sequence, a gold span keeps those tokens. This catches an entity that turns that sequence into a bare `&` within a text span.

name: no_quote_normalization
rationale: Smart or curly quotes in an entity must also appear in the text. This catches quote normalization that changes characters.

name: accents_preserved
rationale: Every non-ASCII character in a correct entity comes from the text. This catches invented diacritics or substituted Unicode characters.

name: digits_in_text
rationale: Any digit in a gold span appears in the text. This catches hallucinated years or numbers.

name: entity_consecutive_tokens_adjacent
rationale: Consecutive words of a gold span are adjacent tokens in the text. This catches entities that splice together non-adjacent words or drop words in between, such as `D & E procedure`.
